title: Business Administration: Human Resources Specialized Area
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Business Administration: Human Resources Specialized Area- Certificate of Achievement - CE1111
outcomes: Use technology to strategize the human capital and management of human resources.
Have an understanding of legal practices relating to business practices, including labor law.
Analyze the business elements that comprise the motivation and training component.
Develop and apply principles of moral judgment and ethical behavior to business situations.
Anticipate and pose problems relative to understanding and supervising personnel. Identify and analyze human relations techniques appropriate to a managerial role.

notes: The catalog prints codes with hyphens (e.g., BUS-10); these match the closed-list codes written with spaces (BUS 10, etc.).

A second heading, 'Human Resources - Locally Approved Certificate - CE868', appears beneath the Certificate of Achievement heading; the requirements and outcomes appear to be shared, and the outcomes list is printed once for the program as a whole and recorded for this award.

Several courses are labeled '( Historical )' in the catalog (BUS-10, BUS-10H, BUS-47, MAG-47, MAG-52, MAG-53); only MAG-56 is marked '( Active )'. A reviewer may wish to confirm these courses are still offered for the 2026-2027 catalog year.
The final outcome is printed as one line containing two sentences; it is recorded as a single entry as printed.
